title: The Mongols

hook.deadpan: 1206. Temüjin unites the steppe tribes and takes a new name: Genghis Khan. The neighbours are nervous.
hook.epic: Out of the steppe: the largest land empire the world has ever seen.

beats: Zhongdu falls
Genghis Khan takes Zhongdu. Today it's called Beijing.
1215: the Jin capital, Zhongdu, falls.
Samarkand falls
The Shah of Khwarazm kills Mongol envoys. This turns out to be a mistake.
Samarkand falls. Central Asia is broken in two years.
Kalka River
A Mongol raiding party beats the Rus princes. Just a raiding party.
Kalka River: the Rus meet the Mongols for the first time, and lose.
Caizhou
The Jin dynasty ends. Northern China is Mongol.
1234: the Jin dynasty falls.
Kyiv falls
Kyiv falls. The Rus princes start paying tribute.
Kyiv burns. The Rus will pay tribute for two centuries.
Mohi
Poland and Hungary, two battles in three days. Then the Great Khan dies and everyone goes home.
Legnica and Mohi: Europe's armies crushed in three days.
Baghdad sacked
The Caliph refuses to surrender. The Caliph should have surrendered.
1258: Baghdad falls, and the Abbasid Caliphate with it.
Ain Jalut
The Mamluks of Egypt finally beat them.
Ain Jalut: the Mamluks stop the Mongol advance.
Yuan dynasty proclaimed
Kublai Khan starts a Chinese dynasty: the Yuan.
Kublai Khan proclaims the Yuan dynasty.
Yamen
The Song dynasty's last stand is at sea. It ends there too.
Yamen: the Song dynasty falls. All of China is Mongol.
Japan invaded again
Kublai invades Japan again. A typhoon wrecks the fleet.
1281: the 'divine wind' destroys the invasion fleet.
end_card: Every year. Every border. Explore it yourself.
